text:
Power 
 Station | Technical 
 Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, 
which must be performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title 
block.
The first draft initiated 
by eng. Saady Ahmed Mohamed Yahie, tested by eng. 
Ibrahem Mohamed Abdel Rahman, accepted by eng.Hassan Refaie Hessain general 
director, revised by EDEPC quality control eng. Adel Abd EL-Qader El Nagar, and approved by eng. Fawzy 
Sobhy Ismaiel 
Head Sector of Abu Sultan PS.
This document accepted by eng. 
Samir Abdel Gilil EDEPC MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant Mahmoud 
Mohamed Soliman EDEPC admin. & financial inspection, and quality control general 
director and supervisor of inspection & quality control's head sector.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff 
 should carry the suitable safety category.
Maintenance staff should be well trained, qualified or 
 directly supervised by some one who is.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.
Wear the personal protective equipment must used as safety 
 shoes, safety helmet, earplug, and gloves pairs...etc
Tools and 
Equipment
Suitable tool set, Air Blower, Megger device
Greasing machine, Multimeter.
Fine cloth for cleaning purposes
Brushes, (soft brushes)
Work to be Carried out
Clean the external surface of the motor.
Clean the stator and rotor winding.
Inspect the 
 bearing.
Lubricate the 
 bearing.
Clean the 
 filters.
Check oil 
 level and cooler for oil leak
Carry out 
 insulation test.
Clean the 
 bearing housing of the motor.
Ensure 
 that the fan is fixed on rotor shaft in the right direction.
Carry out 
 DC resistance test.
Step # | Item | Reference Value | Result
1. | Check the dc resistance of motor winding. |  | 
2. | Clean the body of the motor | OK - Not OK | 
3. | Clean the ventilation holes | OK - Not OK | 
4. | Check the ball bearings. grease, lubricate | OK - Not OK | 
5. | Check the electrical connections for tightness | OK - Not OK | 
6. | Check the cleaning of the motor | OK - Not OK | 
7. | Check ball bearings housing temperature | OK - Not OK | 
8. | Check the vibration or noises | OK - Not OK | 
9. | Check operation of the motor from local and remote 
 operation on test position | OK - Not OK | 
10. | Check all protections of the motor by protection 
 group
 ( OC , SC, UV ) | OK - Not OK |

sections_ar.text: توضح هذه الوثيقة فحص المعدات I1، الذي يجب تنفيذه على أساس سنوي كما هو موضح بـ Y1 في خانة العنوان.

بدأ المسودة الأولى م. Saady Ahmed Mohamed Yahie، واختبرها م. Ibrahem Mohamed Abdel Rahman، وقبلها م. Hassan Refaie Hessain المدير العام، وراجعها م. Adel Abd EL-Qader El Nagar مهندس مراقبة الجودة في EDEPC، واعتمدها م. Fawzy Sobhy Ismaiel رئيس قطاع محطة Abu Sultan PS.

قبل هذه الوثيقة م. Samir Abdel Gilil منسق MPIS في EDEPC، وصدّق عليها المحاسب Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman المدير العام للتفتيش الإداري والمالي ومراقبة الجودة والمشرف على قطاع التفتيش ومراقبة الجودة في EDEPC.

items: يجب إصدار تصريح عمل ويجب أن يحمل طاقم الصيانة فئة السلامة المناسبة.
يجب أن يكون طاقم الصيانة مدرّبًا ومؤهلًا جيدًا أو خاضعًا لإشراف مباشر من شخص مؤهل.
يلزم وجود سياج أمان مع علامات تحذير تحيط بمنطقة العمل.
